figureAudit.note: decksTotal counts transcribed decks; 'available' counts the 2026 edition's nine decks only. All three decks were transcribed by Sonnet from their native 1280x720 page JPEGs and audited by a separate Sonnet agent with enlarged crops. Lecture 1: 14 table-, chart-, number- and code-heavy pages, 0 discrepancies; the parent also checked slides 39 and 106 and a crop of slide 86. Lecture 2: 18 diagram-, equation-, code- and heat-map pages (7, 8, 24, 26, 27, 28, 36, 44, 53, 54, 56, 63, 72, 75-77, 79, 80), 2 small discrepancies fixed (a code-indentation note on slide 28, an ellipsis that is not on slide 63); the parent also checked slides 77 and 79. Lecture 3: 19 matrix-, kernel-, formula-, code-, chart- and diagram-heavy pages (12, 13, 16, 27, 29, 30, 36, 40, 41, 46, 47, 49, 53, 54, 57, 61, 63, 65, 68), discrepancies on 6 of them, all fixed: slide 12's stated digit uncertainty was unfounded (all 192 cells matched); slide 29's X is 9x9, not 8x8; the green boxes on slides 53-54 and slide 53's mixed quote marks; slide 57 has five reader points per panel, not four, and only panel b labels its y-axis; slide 61's dots. The parent also checked slides 57 and 65 and found slide 65's loss printed with one closing parenthesis, which reader and auditor had both balanced.

images.format: whole slides, the deck's own 1280x720 page JPEGs extracted byte for byte, named slide-N by PDF page number
images.discovery: inline in wiki/ and raw/slides/; no index file
images.note: Lecture 1: 34 of 108 pages; lecture 2: 33 of 83 pages; lecture 3: 33 of 70 pages; in each, every slide with a distinct figure. Not included: logistics, logos, portraits and prize/stock/application photos, decorative slides, text-only slides, code and tables transcribed exactly, video stills, and build steps contained in an included slide; the lists are in BUILD_LOG.md. No other lecture is in this KB, so none has images.

caveats: Covers lectures 1-3 of the 2026 edition only: 3 of the catalog's 90 recordings.

The decks are flattened PDFs with no text layer and no printed slide numbers. Slide N is PDF page N, and everything in raw/slides/ was read visually from 1280x720 page images; there is no higher-resolution source.
Transcripts are YouTube auto-captions, lightly copy-edited. The verbatim captions are in raw/transcripts/original/.
Slide images are 1280x720, the deck's native resolution, below the 1400px used in sibling KBs.

Some slide code and formulas are reproduced as printed, including the slides' own slips (lecture 1: slide 82's tf.keras.optimizer, slide 86's update step; lecture 2: slide 27 writes matrix products with *, slide 28's 'from tf.keras.layers import SimpleRNN'; lecture 3: slides 53-54 pass filter_size where slide 47 uses kernel_size, slide 54 calls nn.Sequential with only torch imported, slide 65's loss has an unclosed parenthesis); the slide files note each one.
Lecture 2's slides and lecturer call the scaled dot product of query and key the 'cosine similarity', and give its denominator only as 'scaling'; the wiki reports this as the course states it.
Lecture 2 says vision transformers will be covered in lecture 3; lecture 3 as delivered covers convolutional networks and does not mention them.
